# 35. Search Insert Position

## Solution 1 (O(log(n)))

```python
# Binary search
class Solution(object):
    def searchInsert(self, nums, target):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type target: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        l, r = 0, len(nums) - 1
        while l <= r:
            mid = l + (r - l) // 2
            if target == nums[mid]:
                return mid
            elif (target < nums[mid] and
                (mid == 0 or target > nums[mid - 1])):
                return mid
            elif target > nums[mid] and mid == len(nums) - 1:
                return mid + 1
            elif target > nums[mid]:
                l = mid + 1
            else:
                r = mid - 1
```
